organize.grid.move-earlier.note: printcraft organize.rs organize_toolbar: Edit::MovePages of the target pages to first - 1; off at the first page.

organize.grid.move-later.note: printcraft organize.rs organize_toolbar: Edit::MovePages of the target pages to first + 1; off at the last page.

organize.grid.larger.note: The pages in the grid grow by 1.25 up to 300 %.

organize.grid.smaller.note: The pages in the grid shrink by 1.25 down to 50 %.

organize.grid.reset-size.note: The percentage: a click goes back to 100 %.

organize.more.transitions.note: The engine only (printcraft organize/transition.rs set_transition): the upstream catalogue lists Page transitions as planned (M4) and has no dialog, so the command takes its settings as parameters.

organize.more.templates.note: Hidden: upstream lists Page templates with no command or dialog (planned), so there is nothing to translate.
